scope: Earth evidence for the lunar sturgeon assessment, rebuilt on the hydrosphere's cold-waters study. Literature synthesis and proposed accounting and trials; no new biological validation.

sources.title: Acipenser baerii: Cultured aquatic species fact sheet
sources.kind: Official expert species and culture account
sources.access: Full account; habitat, reproduction, production-cycle and rearing passages inspected
sources.supports: Freshwater migration, differing native/culture maturation, stage-specific temperatures and reproductive egg collection.
sources.limits: Historical practice summary. Ovulated egg collection of 8-14% female mass is not finished caviar yield; tolerance is not a production optimum. No current production statistics inferred.

sources.title: Huso huso: Caspian Biodiversity Information System species account
sources.kind: Archived regional expert account compiling field observations
sources.access: Thermal occurrence, reproduction, migrations and diet passages inspected; re-read on 2026-11-07 for spawning, development and maturity values
sources.supports: Beluga anadromy and piscivory; spawning in the Ural at 7-11 C (winter run) and 10-15 C (spring run) and in the Volga at 6-16 C, at 10-30 m depth and 1-2.5 m/s; eggs and larvae developing at 9-15 C; underyearlings and juveniles at 15-26 C; adults through 20-31 C in summer; most males mature at 12-15 years and females at 15-20.
sources.limits: Occurrence temperatures are not chronic controlled tolerances. Historical populations and conservation classifications do not establish present status or lunar capacity.

sources.title: Sturgeon hatchery practices and management for release: Guidelines
sources.kind: FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture Technical Paper 570, Chebanov et al.
sources.access: Official PDF and indexed sterlet species passage; relevant species/habitat sections, not a complete manual audit
sources.supports: Sterlet freshwater habitat, gravel spawning, benthic feeding and population-dependent maturity.
sources.limits: Earth species/population accounts; no prediction of lunar spawning cues, site suitability or generations to adaptation.

sources.title: Sturgeon reproduction manual
sources.kind: Coppens International industry manual, hosted by Oregon DFW
sources.access: PDF biology, commercial products and reproduction passages inspected
sources.supports: Cultured species/products and managed reproduction involving conditioning, induction, fertilization and incubation.
sources.limits: Government hosting does not make this a government-authored standard. Practical guidance is not a controlled comparative experiment or evidence of autonomous recruitment.

sources.title: Developmental responses of sterlet (Acipenser ruthenus) to temperature modulation with insights into intestinal and morphological traits
sources.kind: Primary experiment
sources.access: Publisher abstract and full-text methods passages including Table 3 thermal schedule; direct access intermittent
sources.supports: Early developmental plasticity under 18, 21 and 27 C treatments; 27 C reached at day 17 and held through day 32 after fertilization, followed by return to ambient treatment.
sources.limits: Three replicates per treatment. Warming started after early development; no warm fertilization, lifetime exposure, inherited response or autonomous reproduction demonstrated.

sources.title: Oxythermal window drastically constraints the survival and development of European sturgeon early life phases
sources.kind: Primary experiment
sources.access: PubMed primary abstract, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30632040/
sources.supports: Embryonic interaction of temperature and oxygen: no survival at 30 C and no hatch at oxygen saturation at or below 50% in the tested conditions.
sources.limits: Results are specific to A. sturio embryos. They supply no beluga, bester or sterlet limits.

sources.title: Preliminary observations on the effects of holding temperature on reproductive performance of female white sturgeon, Acipenser transmontanus Richardson
sources.kind: Primary experiment
sources.access: Indexed publisher abstract; direct publisher open blocked
sources.supports: Small comparison of seasonal 10-15 C, constant 15 C and constant 18 C holding; reproductive performance depended on thermal history.
sources.limits: Five females per group and induced reproduction. Does not establish a universal sturgeon cold-conditioning requirement or autonomous spawning.

sources.title: Increases in the mean and variability of thermal regimes result in differential phenotypic responses among genotypes during early ontogenetic stages of lake sturgeon (Acipenser fulvescens)
sources.kind: Primary family experiment
sources.access: PubMed abstract and indexed full-text family/heritability passages; direct PMC access intermittent
sources.supports: Family-by-thermal-treatment differences in early traits; reason to examine family-specific responses.
sources.limits: Family effects and broad-sense estimates do not isolate additive genetic gain or transfer a heritability to another species. No forecast of warm-life-cycle selection response.

sources.title: The influence of oocyte maturational stage on hatching and triploidy rates in hybrid bester sturgeon Huso huso x Acipenser ruthenus
sources.kind: Primary reproductive experiment
sources.access: Indexed publisher abstract; direct publisher open blocked
sources.supports: Second-generation bester broodstock, variable hatch and spontaneous triploidy associated with oocyte maturation state.
sources.limits: Does not imply all hybrids are sterile or all F2 fish have poor hatch; managed reproduction does not demonstrate natural recruitment.

sources.title: Temperature influence in embryogenesis on fish-breeding parameters of bester hybrid juveniles
sources.kind: Primary experiment, Zuevskiy et al.
sources.access: Indexed publisher English abstract and bibliographic metadata; full methods not inspected
sources.supports: Aksay sterlet-backcross F4; different incubation temperatures optimize different hatch/survival/growth outcomes.
sources.limits: The reported 16 C optimum is the authors' treatment-level conclusion, not a universal optimum. Faster growth after 18-20 C incubation included early egg losses.

sources.title: Oogenesis of bester hybrids (female Huso huso (Linnaeus, 1758) x male Acipenser ruthenus (Linnaeus, 1758)) during the inter-spawning period while cultured in a recycling system
sources.kind: Primary captive reproductive study
sources.access: Publisher abstract; full conditioning and intervention methods not inspected
sources.supports: Reported 10-12-month interspawning intervals in captive hybrid forms under 20-21 C holding conditions.
sources.limits: No inference of unassisted spawning, absence of colder conditioning, warm embryos or universal annual caviar yield.

sources.title: Effect of different oxygen levels on growth performance, stress response and oxygen consumption in two weight groups of great sturgeon Huso huso
sources.kind: Primary experiment, Bagherzadeh Lakani et al., Iranian Journal of Fisheries Sciences 12(3), 533-549
sources.access: Primary abstract in AGRIS and author-uploaded text; methods inspected for sizes, temperature and diet
sources.supports: Eight-week 2-3, 5-6 and 9-10 mg/L treatments at 18 +/- 0.7 C; low oxygen impaired feeding/growth in approximately 281 g and 1.22 kg fish.
sources.limits: No oxygen design rate adopted for warm lunar fish. Some secondary index snippets lose decimal points in starting weights; inspected methods retain them.

sources.title: Effects of Alternative Dietary Lipid Sources on Growth Performance and Fatty Acid Composition of Beluga Sturgeon, Huso huso, Juveniles
sources.kind: Primary feeding experiment
sources.access: Indexed publisher abstract
sources.supports: 120-day fish/soybean/canola-oil comparison: no detected growth or feed-conversion penalty under tested conditions, with altered fatty-acid profiles.
sources.limits: Approximately 206 g initial juveniles; no lifetime, broodstock, sensory or total feed-resource equivalence established.

sources.title: The influence of different lipid sources and levels on growth, body composition and haematology of Huso huso
sources.kind: Primary feeding experiment, Ahmadi Fackjouri et al.
sources.access: PubMed primary abstract, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21231966/
sources.supports: Six-week dietary-oil trial; muscle and liver lipid increased with dietary lipid level.
sources.limits: Approximately 215 g initial juveniles. No inference of caviar response, desirable fat distribution, lunar physiology or superior taste.

sources.title: Production value, chemical composition and colour of fillets of the reciprocal hybrid of Siberian sturgeon with green sturgeon
sources.kind: Primary composition/yield comparison, Jankowska et al.
sources.access: Publisher abstract; full-text retrieval attempts blocked
sources.supports: Ancestry-related tissue differences and fillet yield expressed relative to gutted/deheaded carcass. Pink parental-hybrid color was not preserved in the studied derivative.
sources.limits: No numeric live-to-cooked yield adopted. Abstract cannot establish diet-independent genetic causation or transfer to bester.

sources.title: Fatty acid composition and volatile compounds of caviar from farmed white sturgeon (Acipenser transmontanus)
sources.kind: Primary caviar/diet experiment, Caprino et al.
sources.access: PubMed primary abstract, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18486649/
sources.supports: Twenty caviar samples from two dietary lipid treatments; caviar fatty-acid composition changed only minimally.
sources.limits: Specific diets, exposure and species; neither general dietary immunity of roe nor a measure of beluga flesh response.

sources.title: The contribution of sturgeon species and processing conditions on caviar texture, metabolomic profile and sensory traits
sources.kind: Primary product/metabolomic/sensory comparison, Rocchetti et al.
sources.access: PubMed primary abstract, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39369608/
sources.supports: Eight products from six species; beluga peptide profile, sensory differences and effects associated with processing.
sources.limits: Products/treatments are not a clean common-garden ancestry experiment. Tested additives are not endorsed as a lunar processing formulation.

sources.title: Effects of microbial diversity and phospholipids on flavor profile of caviar from hybrid sturgeon (Huso dauricus x Acipenser schrencki)
sources.kind: Primary caviar study
sources.access: Indexed publisher and PubMed abstract; direct PubMed open challenged
sources.supports: Flavor-associated microbial and phospholipid differences in Kaluga-Amur hybrid caviar.
sources.limits: No causal culinary recipe, full life-cycle thermal suitability or equivalence to Huso huso inferred.

sources.title: Fish and Fishery Products Hazards and Controls
sources.kind: Official FDA guidance
sources.access: Current index rechecked; relevant parasite, harvest-area and toxin guidance previously inspected for this food study
sources.supports: Product-specific hazard controls for raw, cooked, cured and packaged seafood.
sources.limits: No certification of a lunar fishery or preparation; a freezing-speed description is not a validated parasite-control process.

sources.title: Migratory monarch butterfly now Endangered - IUCN Red List
sources.kind: Official IUCN press release of the Red List update of 21 July 2022
sources.access: Press release read in full for its sturgeon passages, 2026-11-07
sources.supports: All 26 surviving sturgeon species threatened (85% in 2009); 17 Critically Endangered, 3 Endangered, 5 Vulnerable; the Yangtze sturgeon Extinct in the Wild and the Chinese paddlefish extinct; beluga Huso huso Critically Endangered.
sources.limits: Names few species; the categories of sterlet, Siberian and Russian sturgeon come from ST21. The species assessments themselves were not opened.

sources.title: Sturgeon slipping towards extinction: chances of survival dimming for world's most threatened group of species
sources.kind: WWF Central and Eastern Europe news account of the IUCN update of 21 July 2022
sources.access: Page read in full, 2026-11-07
sources.supports: Sterlet moved to a higher category and classified Endangered; wild Siberian sturgeon moved to Critically Endangered; Europe's eight species seven Critically Endangered and one Endangered (the sterlet), from which the Russian sturgeon's Critically Endangered status follows; almost two-thirds of the group Critically Endangered.
sources.limits: A secondary account by a conservation organization; kaluga, Amur, white and lake sturgeon not covered. Congiu, Gessner and Ludwig's note in Oryx 57(1): 9-10 (2023) was consulted and gave no species categories in its readable text.

inherited_references.scope: Fresh water above about 15 C everywhere; the highland lakes' air and water (543 lakes below 20 C covering 220,000 km2, 15 below 18 C covering 583 km2; a 30 m lake's floor at 21.1-21.7 C); the ponds' cold hours; no polar winter with the axis 1.5 degrees from the ecliptic. A first estimate on the design years, today's orientation.

The deep lakes' oxygen of 5.7-6.3 mg/L by Osborn's rule and 3.5 under Shih and Bouffard's form at 301 K (19 October); the rules for what lives wild (12 October and 6 November); the waters' trophic design (19 October); organisms crossing between worlds (6 November).
Nitrification stoichiometry; no new sturgeon coefficients
The closed systems' mean power for fed eel at 8 billion people and 1 kg of cooked eel each, used as a scale for chilling
